==English==

===Etymology===
From {{suffix|en|caution<alt:cauti(on)>|ous}}.<ref>{{R:OED Online|pos=adj|id=1078227499}}</ref> Compare {{cog|la|cautus}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɔːʃəs/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkoːʃəs/|a=SSB,AU,NZ}}
* {{a|en|US}}
** {{enPR|kôshn|a=non-cot-caught}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈkɔʃəs/}}
** {{enPR|käshn|a=cot-caught}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈkɑʃəs/}}
*** {{audio|en|en-us-cautious.ogg|a=US,cot-caught}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɔʃəs/|a=Scotland}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɔːʃəs|s=2}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# Using or exercising [[caution]]; [[careful]]; [[tentative]]
#: {{ux|en|He took a few '''cautious''' steps toward the cave.}}

====Synonyms====
* See also [[Thesaurus:cautious]]

====Antonyms====
* {{l|en|careless}}, {{l|en|incautious}}, {{l|en|neglecting}}, {{l|en|uncautious}}
